title: Benchmarking Code LLM-as-a-Judge via Constrained Perturbation and Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2512.20159v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code from LLM-assisted development may contain defects like API hallucinations, motivating the development of code evaluation metrics to assess such code before deployment. As conventional rule-based metrics merely score code based on similarity to reference programs, and execution-based metrics require expensive manual preparation for tests, researchers have developed LLM-as-a-judge metrics for both behavioral and nonbehavioral code evaluation, and curated multiple benchmarks to validate their effectiveness. However, such benchmarks suffer from critical limitations: Some feature coarse-grained binary labels of passing/failing unit tests, unable to distinguish between fundamental and minor flaws; others utilize fine-grained criteria with manually annotated scores as ground-truth, but such criteria are often vaguely defined, introducing subjectivity and unreliability in human scores. Furthermore, they often directly prompt LLMs

translated_title: 通过约束扰动与校准对代码大语言模型评审进行基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM辅助开发所生成的代码可能包含API幻觉等缺陷，这促使研究人员开发代码评估指标，以便在部署前对此类代码进行评估。由于传统的基于规则的指标仅根据与参考程序的相似性对代码打分，而基于执行的指标需要昂贵的人工测试准备，研究人员开发了用于行为与非行为代码评估的LLM-as-a-judge指标，并整理了多个基准来验证其有效性。然而，这些基准存在关键局限性：一些基准采用通过/未通过单元测试的粗粒度二元标签，无法区分根本性缺陷与轻微缺陷；另一些基准则使用带有手动标注分数作为真实标签的细粒度标准，但此类标准往往定义模糊，导致人工评分存在主观性和不可靠性。此外，它们通常直接提示LLM……
tldr: 该论文提出通过约束扰动与校准技术构建代码LLM-as-a-Judge评估基准，克服了现有基准中粗粒度二元标签无法区分缺陷严重程度以及细粒度人工评分主观不可靠的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks code LLM-as-a-Judge via constrained perturbation and calibration, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that suffer from coarse-grained binary labels unable to distinguish flaw severity and unreliable subjective human scores from vaguely defined fine-grained criteria.
